camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLivePackageConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName StreamName --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Protocol HLS_CMAF --SegmentNum 3 --SegmentDuration 5 --AppName AppName
description_zh: 调用UpdateLivePackageConfig更新直播封装配置
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-package-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name StreamName --protocol HLS_CMAF --segment-num 3 --segment-duration 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePackageConfig

parameters.help_en: The primary domain name for live streaming playback
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The application name. The template applies only when this AppName matches the application name in the ingest URL. The AppName can be up to 255 characters and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It cannot start with a hyphen or an underscore. Set this parameter to an asterisk (*) to match all application names
parameters.help_zh: AppName 名称与推流地址中的 AppName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. The template applies only when this StreamName matches the stream name in the ingest URL. The StreamName can be up to 255 characters and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It cannot start with a hyphen or an underscore. Set this parameter to an asterisk (*) to match all stream names
parameters.help_zh: StreamName 名称与推流地址中的 StreamName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol and container format for live streaming. Valid values:

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS (low latency)

LLHLS_CMAF (low latency)

DASH_CMAF

HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.help_zh:
直播协议与封装格式。取值：

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
（低延迟）

LLHLS_CMAF（低延迟）
DASH_CMAF
HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The number of M3U8 segments. The value must be an integer from 3 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 直播M3U8切片个数。取值范围：3～10
parameters.name: segment_num

parameters.help_en:
The segment duration in seconds.

If you set Protocol to HLS_CMAF, the value can range from 1 to 10 s.

If you set Protocol to LLHLS_*, the value can range from 1 to 2 s
parameters.help_zh:
切片时长，单位：秒。

如Protocol为HLS_CMAF，取值范围1～10s。

如Protocol为LLHLS_*，取值范围1～2s
parameters.name: segment_duration

parameters.help_en:
The duration of a part segment in milliseconds.

This parameter is required if you set \`Protocol\` to \`LLHLS\_\*\`.

If SegmentDuration is 1 s, the value can range from 100 to 500 ms.

If SegmentDuration is 2 s, the value can range from 100 to 1000 ms
parameters.help_zh:
Part切片时长，单位：毫秒。

当Protocol为LLHLS_*时，该参数为必填项。
SegmentDuration为1s时，取值范围100～500ms。
SegmentDuration为2s时，取值范围100～1000ms
parameters.name: part_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore transcoded streams. Valid values:

true (default): Ignore transcoded streams.

false: Do not ignore transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略转码流，取值：

true（默认值）：忽略。

false：不忽略
parameters.name: ignore_transcode
